name: TOB Sunday School Settings
description: Tunable point values for the Sunday School weekly rewards system, read by truth_of_bible.sunday_school.engine on every award so an admin can adjust the economy without a code deploy — exposed via the admin control panel's Settings screen.

fields.label: Quiz Points per Mark
fields.description: Multiplier applied to a student's quiz score to get points, e.g. 92 marks × 1 = 92 points. Applies to both Weekly Bible Quiz and Faith Leader Exam.

fields.label: Sunday Goal Bonus Points
fields.description: Awarded once a student completes all 3 Sunday Goal items (class attendance, quiz attendance, memory verse) in the same week.

fields.label: Winner Group Bonus Divisor
fields.description: Each member of the week's top-scoring group gets their own quiz mark ÷ this number added as a bonus. Default 2 matches "Quiz Mark / 2".

fields.label: Points Expire After (days)
fields.description: A student's unredeemed weekly-rewards balance expires this many days after they first had a positive balance, unless they redeem it to their wallet before then. Only this reward system expires — the app-wide points/shop system never does.

fields.label: Wallet Credit per Point
fields.description: Redeeming N points credits the student's app wallet (TOB Reward Wallet Ledger — the same wallet the shop/AI credits use) with N × this amount.

fields.label: Show redeemed & expired points in students' points history
fields.description: On: students see every points row (earned, redeemed, expired) plus totals. Off: students see only the points still available to redeem.
